source: create me a sci-fi shooting game like halo using mesh generation assets. it's an fps shooter and i should be able to run and shoot my gun and also reload the gun. i should have limited health and the opponents should have limited health too. i want to be able to run around hide behind objects etc. it should be an FPS so first person camera view. model it after the game halo. please use your creativity i just want to be able to play something. you'll have to generate a map too so i can run around and there are alien enemies i have to run and shoot down but they can also shoot lasers and attack me too while i move, which would lower my HP

answers.ask: Is this endless waves of aliens, a fixed set of enemies to clear, or a campaign of linked areas?
answers.answer: Use a fixed set of alien enemies to clear; the prompt calls for a plainly playable combat map rather than endless waves or a campaign.

answers.ask: One medium arena, or several connected areas to move between?
answers.answer: Build one medium sci-fi arena with cover and room to run around, keeping the first playable version focused and complete.

config.prompt: create me a sci-fi shooting game like halo using mesh generation assets. it's an fps shooter and i should be able to run and shoot my gun and also reload the gun. i should have limited health and the opponents should have limited health too. i want to be able to run around hide behind objects etc. it should be an FPS so first person camera view. model it after the game halo. please use your creativity i just want to be able to play something. you'll have to generate a map too so i can run around and there are alien enemies i have to run and shoot down but they can also shoot lasers and attack me too while i move, which would lower my HP
config.genre_evidence: The prompt explicitly asks for an "fps shooter" with a "first person camera view," a generated map to "run around hide behind objects," and alien enemies that "shoot lasers" while the player runs, shoots, reloads, and manages health. These describe firing-focused combat spaces with cover and sightlines.
config.evidence: “model it after the game halo” and “run around hide behind objects”; “alien enemies ... shoot lasers and attack me” supports readable enemy wave origins.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Shooter map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Lane Network: Parallel routes, classically three, channelling team traffic into predictable engagement fronts.

INCLUDE:
- Tactical Cover Arrays: Waist-high (3–4 studs) and full-body (7–8 studs) cover distributed evenly across every lane.
